aboutUs.title: About us
aboutUs.description: The Gerege Tourist Passport is a modern travel document and travel log inspired by the Gerege, a diplomatic pass used during the Mongol Empire. It serves as a symbol for promoting Mongolia’s history and culture while enhancing tourism. The Gerege Tourist Passport offers the following benefits:

benefits.title: Opportunity to Explore Mongolia’s History and Culture
benefits.description: Travelers can gain a deeper understanding of Mongolia’s rich historical and cultural heritage by learning about the significance of the Gerege used during the Mongol Empire.

benefits.title: Comprehensive and Convenient Services
benefits.description: The Gerege Passport provides all essential travel information, recommendations, locations, emergency contact numbers, tourism support centers, discounts, and promotions. It is available in English and Korean as a digital solution that allows online purchases, saving travelers time, money, and eliminating language barriers.

benefits.title: Access to Discounts and Benefits
benefits.description: Holders of the Gerege Passport can enjoy exclusive discounts on hotels, tourist camps, museums, transportation, entertainment, and various other services, making their travel more affordable and enjoyable.

benefits.title: A Memorable Travel Souvenir
benefits.description: The Gerege Passport serves as a keepsake that brings back warm travel memories every time you see it. It is not only a practical daily-use item but also a unique addition to any travel collection.

list.title: HushKhan - Mongolian Natural Pine nuts
list.description: Receive a 10g package of Hushhan pine nuts as a complimentary gift when purchasing from Gerege Passport.
list.content:
About the Pine Nuts: The pine nuts are sourced from wild pine trees in Mongolia's untouched forests. These pine nuts thrive in Mongolia's harsh and extreme climate, which allows them to develop high concentrations of essential nutrients and proteins.
Harvesting and Processing: The pine nuts are harvested in accordance with legal timelines, processed at a facility that meets ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22000:2018, and HACCP standards. They undergo 20 stages of cleaning and sorting in a factory across three production lines before being packaged and delivered to customers.
Organic Certification: Hushhan brand pine nuts are certified organic under Mongolia's organic standards and have also become the first in Mongolia to meet the European Union organic certification standards.

list.title: Jet Scooter 5000 MNT Credit
list.description: Jet Sharing Mongolia is the first and largest scooter rental service in Mongolia, offering scooters at a rate of  350 MNT per minute.
list.content:
How to Use the Scooter:
1. Download the App: Install the Jet Scooter app from Appstore or Playstore.
2. Register: Sign up as a user in the app.
3. Top-Up Your Wallet: Tap on the Wallet section in the menu (bottom left) and add credit (minimum 4000 MNT).
4. Scan the QR Code: Scan the QR code on the scooter with the Jet app to begin your ride.
5. Choose Your Tariff: Select your preferred tariff and press the Start button to begin your journey.
6. End Your Ride: You can end your ride at any scooter station marked with the letter "P" on the map.Rules:\nFollow Traffic Rules: Park your scooter in a way that does not block others and always comply with road regulations.
Restricted Areas: Do not enter areas marked in red on the map.
Age Limit: Only individuals aged 18 or older are permitted to rent scooters.
One Rider Per Scooter: It is prohibited to have more than one person riding a scooter.
Safety First: Always walk your scooter safely when crossing streets.
Important Note: Violating the usage rules may result in your account being suspended.

NewsAndTips.title: NEWS AND TIPS
NewsAndTips.description: Here’s many things you can do in Ulaanbaatar for free and others

news.title: Khuvsgul Lake
news.description: Often referred to as the 'Switzerland of Mongolia,' Khuvsgul Lake boasts crystal-clear waters surrounded by majestic mountains and dense forests. It is a popular destination for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts.

news.title: Orkhon Valley
news.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site, the Orkhon Valley is rich in history and culture. It features notable landmarks such as the Orkhon Waterfall, the ancient city of Kharkhorin, and the Erdene Zuu Monastery, offering a glimpse into Mongolia's past.

news.title: Gobi Three Beauties
news.description: Located in Umnugobi Province, this stunning natural area includes breathtaking attractions like Yolyn Am, the Dungenee Rock, and the Khongoryn Els sand dunes, showcasing the unique beauty of the Gobi Desert.

news.title: Khorgo and Terkhiin Tsagaan Lake
news.description: This region in Arkhangai Province features a volcanic crater, unique geological formations, and pristine freshwater lakes, making it an ideal spot for hiking and exploring nature.

news.title: Altai Tavan Bogd
news.description: Situated in western Mongolia, Altai Tavan Bogd is known for its majestic mountains, glacial rivers, and the rich cultural heritage of the nomadic Kazakh people, making it a stunning destination for adventure seekers.

news.title: Amarbayasgalant Monastery
news.description: As one of the largest and oldest monasteries in Mongolia, Amarbayasgalant is a remarkable architectural site that preserves cultural heritage and offers a serene atmosphere for visitors.

news.title: Uvs Lake
news.description: A UNESCO-listed area, the Uvs Lake Basin features a unique landscape that combines steppes, desert, and mountainous regions, providing diverse habitats for wildlife.

news.title: Khustain Nuruu
news.description: Home to the endangered Przewalski's horse, Khustain Nuruu is a protected area dedicated to the conservation and breeding of this rare species in its natural habitat.

news.title: Burkan Khaldun Mountain
news.description: Known as the birthplace of Genghis Khan, Burkan Khaldun Mountain is one of Mongolia's most sacred sites, rich in historical significance and natural beauty.

news.title: Ogii Lake
news.description: Located in Arkhangai Province, Ogii Lake is a picturesque destination ideal for fishing and birdwatching, featuring clear waters and a tranquil environment.

questions.title: How to Use the Gerege Passport?
questions.description: You can use your Gerege Passport by presenting it to partner organizations, scanning the QR code located on the back of the passport, or registering the phone number of the SIM card that accompanies the passport to access services.

questions.title: What to Do If You Lose Your Gerege Passport?
questions.description: If you lose your Gerege Passport, you will need to purchase a new one to continue using the services.

questions.title: How to Activate Your Data SIM?
questions.description: To activate your data SIM, remove it from the package, insert it into your phone, and enter the PIN code provided on the SIM card. The SIM will be activated and usable for 14 days from the activation date.

questions.title: Can You Extend Your Data and Days?
questions.description: Yes, you can extend your data and usage days. You can access suitable services through the following link. Жимобайл ХХК - Үндэсний оператор.

questions.title: Where Can You Purchase a Removable Map?
questions.description: You can purchase a removable map at the Mongolian Costume Rental location. You can check their Facebook page for more information. Mongolian Costume Rental

questions.title: Where Can You Buy Hushkhan Nuts?
questions.description: Hushkhan nuts are available for purchase at all selling points across the country. You can check local stores or visit the website: hushkhan.mn – Хушхан БРЭНД for more details.

questions.title: What Payment Options Are Available?
questions.description: You can make payments using international cards or through the Korean banking app.

questions.title: What Should You Do If You Want to Return Your Gerege Passport for Any Reason?
questions.description: If there are errors or duplicate transactions during payment, you can request a refund for the difference. Returns are not possible in other cases.

questions.title: How Long Will It Take to Receive a Refund?
questions.description: Refunds will be processed within 7-14 days and will be credited to your account.

questions.title: Can You Transfer Your Gerege Passport to Someone Else?
questions.description: The Gerege Passport is non-transferable and cannot be used by others.
